title: Cellar Humidity Cork Risk by Rack
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=winecellar:reading
| stats avg(humidity_pct) as humidity_pct, avg(temp_c) as temp_c by rack
| where humidity_pct<55 OR humidity_pct>75
| sort humidity_pct
description: Uses Wine-cellar environment readings telemetry to monitor rack humidity versus the zone that keeps corks healthy in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for storage zones that need climate adjustment, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Wine-cellar environment readings data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Rack table of cellar humidity and temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It produces rack humidity versus the zone that keeps corks healthy so you can spot storage zones that need climate adjustment before it becomes annoying.
